title: Function-first maintenance mechanism screening contract

status_semantics.PASS: The exact screen item is explicitly established at the stated definition/evidence layer. PASS does not imply mechanical acceptance or superiority.
status_semantics.FAIL: The candidate definition explicitly contradicts the exact screen item. FAIL is bounded to that item and does not rank the candidate.
status_semantics.UNRESOLVED: The candidate definition or admitted evidence does not establish or contradict the exact screen item.

screens.question: Is the candidate an exact unique entry in the current mechanism candidate registry?
Is the candidate explicitly marked ELIGIBLE for bounded investigation?
Is the candidate provenance state explicitly FUNCTION_FIRST_HYPOTHESIS_ONLY?
Does the candidate definition represent a standalone kinematic architecture class rather than a maintenance-law augmentation?
Is an exact physical or accepted deterministic closure/contact-maintenance owner bound?
Are motion type, open/capture/release states, usable travel/range, and limits explicitly bound?
Is the actual unilateral contact-maintenance law explicitly bound, including compliance/force/position behavior as applicable?
Is equivalent rank-sufficient bottle contact proven throughout CAPTURE_AND_ROTATION, LABEL_TRANSFER_INTERVAL, and WRAP_ACTIVE?
Does candidate-specific geometry prove preservation of the already-bound bottle rotation_wrap_axis during maintained contact?
Is the candidate reaction path from contact/closure elements to fixed support explicitly bound?
Is bottle release/opening behavior and downstream clearance explicitly proved?
Is tangential rotation drive/traction explicitly separated and bound relative to normal-force closure?
Are the candidate's required travel/force/preload/stiffness/friction/reaction-capacity inputs authoritatively or deterministically bound?
Are reachable open/closed limits and interference/clearance across entry, transfer, wrap, release, neighbors, CAB hardware, and mounts proved?

interpretation_boundary: A definition-layer PASS establishes only the candidate registry/definition property named by that screen.
An engineering-evidence UNRESOLVED must not be upgraded because the candidate definition contains requirement text describing what should eventually be proved.
A FAIL for standalone kinematic architecture on a maintenance-law augmentation does not make that augmentation unusable when paired with a separately defined parent architecture.
Screen results are not a ranking and cannot select a candidate.
